faqs.q: How can I get help paying my water bill?
faqs.a: The Utility Billing Customer Service team is available to help customers navigate understanding and paying their bills. The City offers two programs to assist with bill payment: Payment plans are available to create equalized payments across a 12 month period. One time hardship credits are available for qualifying customers. Please call the Utility Billing team at 720-898-7070 for more information.
